CHALLENGE C0043 | `tmpdir` is correctly initialized to `None` prior to the `try` block. If `_create_sandbox()` fails internally, its own exception handler cleans up the partial directory before re-raising. Because the assignment unpacking `tmpdir, patched_path = _create_sandbox(...)` is atomic, an exception within the call means the outer `tmpdir` remains `None`. The `finally` block safely executes `if tmpdir:` and skips cleanup. There is no UnboundLocalError or null pointer crash here.

DESCRIPTION: FIND — In `_apply_fix_to_source` Strategy 3 (line-level replacement), the regex `line_pattern` lacks the `re.DOTALL` flag. As a result, the `(.+?)` and `(.+)` capture groups cannot match `old_frag` and `new_frag` if the replacement blocks contain newlines. Since multi-line code replacements inherently span multiple lines, this makes the line-level replacement strategy silently fail for almost all real-world multi-line blocks.
FOLLOW: Multi-line replacement instructions (e.g., `Lines 10-12: old -> new`) containing newlines will fail to match the regex. The fix application will return `None`, causing `evaluate_fix` to abort with "Could not apply proposed fix to source" and log `UNEVALUABLE` for a valid fix.
